doc: Ordered registry of corpus transform stages. A file in tools/stages/ that is not listed here is a hard error in run_stages.py --check: an unregistered stage is a silent skip, which is the failure class this resource was audited for. Ranges are reserved per workstream; see tools/stages/README.md section 1.

reserved_ranges.workstream: metabolite identity, mapping confidence tiers, xref provenance
published-site size: reference tables, string deduplication
derived-artifact rebuild and manifest (not corpus stages)

stages.title: Copy-through baseline: measures the frozen snapshot and proves the harness
Normalize record types, null-vs-empty-vs-missing drift, vocabularies and record-level counters
Verified source identity, true culture collection, citation type, honest verification status, the sourced/derived split on every component, and removal of the per-record licence fields
stages.confirmed_by: licensing agent 2026-09-07: one dataset licence; per-record licence fields removed
stages.notes: Rewrites provenance.citation for the 1,248 MediaDive media that belong to JCM or CCAP, preserving the original in provenance.citation_original. Does NOT rename records: the display-name conflict and a suggested name go to provenance.attribution_conflict for the naming stage (50-59). Deletes no record and no component. The licence fields it removes are replaced by one dataset licence in tools/dataset_license.py; tools/licenses.tsv stays as the record of what each upstream source permits and is read to validate the source vocabulary.

stages.title: Stage 39 — coverage recomputed with its denominator, and derived composition excluded.
stages.registered_by: pipeline harness --register-missing; the owning agent must confirm findings, adds_keys and ordering

stages.title: Honest evidence tiers and chemistry corrections for component mappings
stages.registered_by: pipeline harness, so an in-progress stage is visible instead of silently skipped
stages.enabled_by: rebuild agent 2026-09-06: remap_components.py gained the contract entrypoint (--in/--out/--report/--limit/--dry-run via stagelib.run_stage) in remap_components.stage_main; its legacy --media-dir/--report-only/--sample CLI is unchanged and still drives the chemistry workstream's own tests. Not one line of the transform was altered.
stages.order_note: Runs AFTER 20_stamp_provenance and 39_recompute_coverage, which is safe and was checked rather than assumed: those two stages key on components[].mapping_method, and this stage never writes mapping_method. It rewrites identity (bigg_metabolite, exchange, xref split), tiers and the record counters, none of which 20 or 39 read. The reverse order would not be safe: 39 must see every component classified, and this stage does not classify.
stages.cross_workstream_check: components[].evidence_tier == 'derived_component' (tools/evidence_tiers.METHOD_TIERS) and components[].evidence_class == 'derived' (tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv) are two workstreams' definitions of the same fact. Verified identical: both name exactly base, base_medium_expansion, complex_decomposition, hydrolysate_approximation, mineral_base, oxygen_regime, regime. So record-level n_derived (this stage) and coverage_source.n_derived (stage 39) cannot disagree.

Project the quantitative layer already on disk: verbatim amounts, honest units, derived-only-where-valid concentrations

stages.title: Build and verify the browser payload from the corrected corpus (copy-through)
stages.note: Copy-through: it edits no record and stamps none. It exists so the browser's honesty numbers are asserted inside the chain, against the corrected corpus, before promotion. The shipping path is `make derived` -> tools/build_web_payload.py.

stages.title: No en-dash or em-dash survives in a published string
The record publishes the regime a source stated, and the simulation convention separately
stages.note: No published tally moves. The pair this writes onto the record is exactly what tools/web_payload.oxygen_recorded() already computed from it for the catalogue and the index, so by_oxygen stays {null 12365, anaerobic 749, facultative 210, aerobic 191} and oxygen_basis stays {n_regime_recorded 1150, n_no_source_statement 11926, n_absent_for_another_reason 439}. What changes is the record file, which is a documented public route and was still publishing a confident label where the answer is unknown. It runs after 52_web_payload for the same reason 53_house_voice_dashes does: the payload 52 projects inside the chain is a check, the shipping payload is built by `make derived` over the promoted corpus, and oxygen_recorded() returns the same pair whether it reads the corrected record or derives it from the note vocabulary.

stages.title: Hold each repeated cross-reference block and note once in data/refs.json, and refer to it by key
stages.notes: Deletes no fact. Every removed value is either written once into data/refs.json and referenced by key, or was already present on the same component inside `quantity` (quantity_basis / usda_amount / usda_unit were type-exact copies of quantity.basis / .value / .unit in 665,582 and 268,697 of 268,697 components respectively; amount_basis is left in place because it labels amount_mmol_per_100g, a different measurement, and its agreement with quantity.basis is a property of this corpus rather than of the schema). The stage asserts refs.resolve_component() reproduces every component byte-for-byte, on all 665,582 of them, and exits non-zero on a single failure. Measured: data/media 1,382.3 MiB -> 744.0 MiB; the driver was that `xref` was byte-identical to `target_xref` in 100.00% of components and that 2,287 distinct cross-reference blocks were written out 665,582 times.
stages.runs_last: Ordered after 52_web_payload because every stage before it, and the web payload projection itself, read components[].xref / target_xref / mapping_note inline. Running it earlier would force every upstream stage to join a table for no benefit.
